title: Spicy Mexican Burrito
description: A flavorful and spicy burrito with a delightful crunch from almonds. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: 1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced almonds and cook until lightly toasted.
3. Add the diced jalapenos and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the cooked brown rice and stir to combine.
5. Add the cooked black beans and stir to combine.
6. Warm the flour tortilla in the skillet for 30 seconds on each side.
7. Spoon the rice and bean mixture onto the center of the tortilla.
8. Top with the toasted almonds and fold the tortilla to enclose.
